title: NIKA benchmark
description: Benchmark progress, host resources, and lab resources per task.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: Lab host that pushed the data. Local Prometheus has no host label; All selects everything.

list.name: run_id
list.label: Benchmark run
list.description: Benchmark runs seen in the time range. All also includes sessions started outside a benchmark run.

list.name: session_id
list.label: Task (session)
list.description: Lab sessions; a benchmark trial runs in one session.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Lab nodes of the selected tasks.

panels.title: Completed trials
panels.description: Share of the run's trials with a complete result, per benchmark run.

targets.expr: max by (run_id) (nika_benchmark_trials{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", state="completed"}) / max by (run_id) (nika_benchmark_trials{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", state="total"})

panels.title: Trials
panels.description: Trials in the selected runs, including trials of earlier launches.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Trials with a complete result (an agent failure counts as complete).

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Trials whose lab session is deployed now.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Trials still to run or to retry.

panels.title: Throughput (last hour)
panels.description: Trials completed during the last hour.

panels.title: Estimated time left
panels.description: Pending trials divided by the last hour's throughput.

targets.expr: sum(max by (run_id) (nika_benchmark_trials{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", state="pending"})) / (sum(delta(nika_benchmark_trials{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", state="completed"}[1h])) > 0) * 3600

panels.title: Elapsed
panels.description: Time since this launch of the run started (a resumed run restarts the clock).

panels.title: Since last progress
panels.description: Time since the run last updated its trial counts. A value well above the case timeout suggests a stuck run.

panels.title: Benchmark runs
panels.description: Live runs, and runs that finished in the last 10 minutes.

targets.expr: topk by (run_id) (1, max by (run_id, benchmark_id, version, agent_type, model, status) (max_over_time(timestamp(nika_benchmark_run_info{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id"})[$__range:$__interval])))

panels.title: Peak CPU
panels.description: Highest host CPU use in the time range, in cores.

panels.title: Peak CPU (% of host)
panels.description: Highest host CPU use in the time range, as a share of all cores.

panels.title: Peak memory
panels.description: Highest host memory use (total minus available) in the time range.

panels.title: Peak memory (% of host)
panels.description: Highest host memory use in the time range, as a share of physical memory.

panels.title: Peak lab CPU
panels.description: Highest CPU use of all NIKA lab containers together.

panels.title: Peak lab memory
panels.description: Highest working-set memory of all NIKA lab containers together.

panels.title: Host CPU (cores)
panels.description: Whole-host CPU use, the share used by NIKA lab containers, and the core count.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Host memory in use (total minus available), the working set of NIKA lab containers, and physical memory.

panels.title: CPU by task (cores)
panels.description: CPU use of each task's lab containers, stacked.

panels.title: Memory by task
panels.description: Working-set memory of each task's lab containers, stacked.

panels.title: Task summary
panels.description: One row per task (lab session) seen in the time range. Duration runs from session creation to the last scrape; CPU time includes deployment.

targets.expr: max by (session_id, run_id, scenario, backend) (max_over_time(nika:session_containers{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))

max by (session_id) (max_over_time(timestamp(nika_session_info{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id"})[$__range:$__interval])) - max by (session_id) (max_over_time(nika_session_start_time_seconds{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id"}[$__range]))
sum by (session_id, node) (nika:container_cpu_cores{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id", node=~"$node"})
sum by (session_id, node) (nika:container_memory_working_set_bytes{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id", node=~"$node"})
topk(15, max by (session_id, node) (max_over_time(nika:container_memory_working_set_bytes{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
topk(15, max by (session_id, node) (max_over_time(nika:container_cpu_seconds_total{host=~"$host", run_id=~"$run_id", session_id=~"$session_id", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
